body: <sf-list-attention id="health" triage more-href="#all"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "backup", "status": "warning", "title": "Последняя копия demo-owned.test не удалась", "text": "нет места на диске", "since": "2026-01-05T03:30:00+03:00", "source": "Резервные копии", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "#backups"}, "help": "#help-backups"}, {"id": "down", "status": "error", "title": "demo-php.test не отвечает", "object": {"label": "demo-php.test", "href": "#site-php"}, "since": "2026-01-10T12:00:00+03:00", "action": {"label": "Перезапустить", "event": "restart"}}, {"id": "cert", "status": "warning", "title": "Сертификат demo-static.test истекает через 6 дней", "action": {"label": "Продлить", "href": "#cert"}}, {"id": "old", "status": "warning", "title": "Обмен с 1С стоит", "since": "2026-01-01T09:00:00+03:00", "source": "Интеграции", "dismissible": true}, {"id": "update", "status": "info", "title": "Доступна панель 0.3.1", "text": "Изменения: журнал, резервные копии"}, {"id": "seo", "status": "info", "title": "38 страниц без описания", "affected": "38 страниц"}, {"id": "php", "status": "info", "title": "PHP 8.1: поддержка заканчивается", "affected": "4 сайта"}]}</script></sf-list-attention>

checks.title: the items are ordered error, warning, info, inside a status the longest-lasting first (since), then the host's order; the head shows a badge per severity in words; the section is named by its heading; frame card by default
checks.covers: settings.items, settings.label, settings.heading-level, settings.frame, accessibility.role region, host-states data-status

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#health'); const root = el.querySelector('section.sf-list-attention'); const heading = document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const ids = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-item')].map((li) => li.dataset.id).join(','); const badges = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-summary sf-badge')].map((b) => b.getAttribute('text')).join('|'); return ids === 'down,old,backup,cert,update' && badges === '1 ошибка|3 предупреждения|3 рекомендации' && heading.getAttribute('role') === 'heading' && heading.getAttribute('aria-level') === '3' && heading.textContent.trim() === 'Требует внимания' && el.getAttribute('data-status') === 'error' && root.classList.contains('sf-list-attention--frame-card') && el.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-item .sr-only').textContent === 'Ошибка: ' && el.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-item .sf-list-attention-icon').classList.contains('sf-icon--filled'); })()

checks.title: an action with href is a link; its press asks sf-list-attention-navigate {id, status, href, part}, cancelable; the object link asks it too
an action with event is a quiet button (outline, on-surface); its press sends sf-list-attention-apply {action, scope entry, ids}

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#health [data-id=down] sf-button.sf-list-attention-action'); return b.getAttribute('appearance') === 'outline' && b.getAttribute('scheme') === 'on-surface'; })()

checks.title: with no items empty line (the default) draws the head and one quiet line with the time of the checks; empty none takes no room; a new list draws again

steps.check: (() => { const none = document.querySelector('#none'); const quiet = document.querySelector('#quiet'); const line = quiet.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-quiet'); return none.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && !none.querySelector('.sf-list-attention') && line.getAttribute('role') === 'status' && /^Проверки пройдены · проверено /u.test(line.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-quiet-text').textContent.trim()) && Boolean(quiet.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-head [role=heading]')) && quiet.querySelector('.sf-list-attention').getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; })()

checks.title: limit 5 by default: the rest are behind «Все проблемы (7)», a link to more-href whose press asks sf-list-attention-more {href}, cancelable; without more-href «Показать все (7)» shows them in place

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#health'); const all = el.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-all'); return el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-item').length === 5 && all.getAttribute('text') === 'Все проблемы (7)' && all.getAttribute('href') === '#all'; })()

checks.title: triage: the «⋯» opens a menu of snooze a day / a week; a choice asks sf-list-attention-snooze {id, until}, sets the item aside with a notice, and «Вернуть» brings it back with sf-list-attention-undo

steps.check: (() => { const more = document.querySelector('#health [data-id=cert] .sf-list-attention-more button'); return more.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Ещё: Сертификат demo-static.test истекает через 6 дней' && more.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu'; })()

(() => { const menu = document.querySelector('#health .sf-list-attention-menu'); const texts = (menu.entries || []).map((one) => one.text || one.type).join('|'); return texts === 'Отложить на день|Отложить на неделю'; })()

(() => { const ids = [...document.querySelectorAll('#health .sf-list-attention-item')].map((li) => li.dataset.id); const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.sf-notifications .sf-toast')].find((one) => one.textContent.includes('Отложено на неделю: Сертификат demo-static.test')); return !ids.includes('cert') && Boolean(toast); })()

steps.script: (() => { const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.sf-notifications .sf-toast')].find((one) => one.textContent.includes('Отложено на неделю')); [...toast.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Вернуть').click(); return true; })()

checks.title: «Не напоминать» only where the person may: the item's dismissible, else the host's; a choice asks sf-list-attention-dismiss {id}; a cancelled request changes nothing

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#health'); const entries = (id) => el.menuEntries(el.list.find((one) => one.id === id)).map((one) => one.id).filter(Boolean).join(','); return entries('cert') === 'snooze-day,snooze-week' && entries('old') === 'snooze-day,snooze-week,dismiss' && entries('backup') === 'snooze-day,snooze-week,help'; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#health'); return el.menuEntries(el.list.find((one) => one.id === 'cert')).some((one) => one.id === 'dismiss'); })()

checks.title: group severity: a disclosure group per severity, open, and «Пройдено» closed; a header press opens it; checked-at draws the time and a recheck that sends sf-list-attention-recheck

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#page'); const toggles = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-group-toggle')].map((b) => `${b.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-group-title').textContent}:${b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')}`).join('|'); const passed = el.querySelector('[data-group=passed] .sf-list-attention-list'); return toggles === 'Ошибки:true|Предупреждения:true|Пройдено:false' && passed.hidden && el.querySelectorAll('[data-group=warning] .sf-list-attention-item').length === 3; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#page'); const passed = el.querySelector('[data-group=passed] .sf-list-attention-list'); return !passed.hidden && passed.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-item').length === 2 && el.querySelector('[data-group=passed] .sf-list-attention-group-toggle').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()
